instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all fonts (Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, JetBrains Mono) are loaded via HTML link in index.html or Google Fonts @import in index.css.
Implement carbon fiber texture via CSS background variables and SVG pattern class .bg-carbon-pattern.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations and hover effects on video cards.
All navigation links and call-to-action buttons MUST link directly or prominently highlight https://youtube.com/@oliseee1117.
Ensure video section supports real YouTube embed modals/lightboxes using iframe.
Include data-testid attributes on every interactive element specified in the section blueprints.
Maintain high contrast ratios with readable text on dark carbon backgrounds.
